subtitles.text: In 1896, Britain fought a war so fast, their soldiers barely finished their morning tea.
The new Sultan of Zanzibar essentially told the British: 'You wouldn't dare shoot at me.'
At 9:02 AM, the Royal Navy said: 'Bet.'
Five British warships opened fire, blasting 500 explosive shells directly into his wooden palace.
By 9:40 AM... just 38 minutes later... the Sultan fled, his palace was in ruins, and the war was over.
British casualties? Exactly one wounded sailor. Truly the most efficient war in human history.
